slices.focus: Crews game weather category; Jae-hyun adds source notes and reviews.
slices.summary: During an ugly August storm stretch, crews throw nearly every delay into the weather column to avoid scrutiny. Jae-hyun discovers a missed paperwork delay hidden behind a weather label and adds mandatory written delay-source notes for all problem entries plus a post-shift review. The change shifts the pilot from color-coding to enforced written cause trails with credibility checks.
